entries.prompt: Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A dark blue night sky above a quiet hillside with a row of Moons across the sky showing the phases in order: thin crescent, half Moon, gibbous, full Moon, each lit from the same side. The lit part is pale silver with soft craters; the unlit part is barely visible. Must NOT show: a face on the Moon, stars inside the dark part of the Moon, a crescent lit on the inside curve, or Earth's shadow drawn on the Moon.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. An old stone arch bridge with one wide, round arch crossing a calm river, its two ends resting firmly on stone banks; a horse and cart are crossing on top. Green countryside, soft sky. The curve of the arch and where it meets the ground at each end are clearly visible. Must NOT show: cracks, a collapsing bridge, cars, a suspension bridge, or a troll under the bridge.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A child (simple, no name, in sports clothes) standing in a park after running, one hand resting gently on the left side of their chest, cheeks pink. A soft, warm glow marks the heart area under the hand, slightly left of centre. Must NOT show: a cartoon love-heart shape, an anatomical cut-away, blood, a stethoscope, or a heart on the right side.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A single deciduous tree in autumn on a gentle hill: mostly yellow and orange leaves with some red ones and a few still green, several leaves drifting down, a scatter of fallen leaves on the grass. Low golden light. One leaf in the foreground shows green fading into yellow. Must NOT show: palm trees, pine trees, snow, bare winter branches, or leaves with faces.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A glassmaker in a workshop holding a long metal blowpipe with a glowing orange blob of molten glass on its end, beside the bright open mouth of a furnace; on a shelf behind, a few finished clear glass bottles catch the light. The worker wears simple protective gloves. Must NOT show: a child holding hot glass, flames bursting out of the furnace, a kitchen oven, or broken glass.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A wide view of distant hills under a dark storm cloud, one bright branching bolt of lightning from the cloud to the hills far away; in the foreground a child (simple, no name) watches safely from indoors through a closed window. Must NOT show: lightning striking the house or the child, a child outdoors in the storm, cartoon zigzag lightning, sound-wave lines, or the words 'boom' or 'crash'.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A child (simple, no name) on a smooth path easily pulling a large wheeled suitcase by its handle; beside the path, a heavy cardboard box of the same size sits on the ground with no wheels. The suitcase wheels are clearly visible and round. Must NOT show: motion lines, arrows, a car, a skateboard, or any lettering on the box or suitcase.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A one-humped Arabian camel (dromedary) walking across sandy desert dunes under a hot pale sky, its wide padded feet pressing shallowly into the sand, long eyelashes visible. Must NOT show: a two-humped camel, water sloshing in the hump, a saddle or rider, an oasis with palm trees in front, cacti, or a camel with a cartoon face.

Soft classic watercolour storybook illustration on cream paper, gentle washes and fine pencil-like edges, same family as the approved 'A Trip Through Space' book. Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, letters or arrows anywhere in the image. A walker (simple adult hiker, no name) on a misty green hillside holding an open, round compass in one hand; the compass is large in the foreground, its thin needle balanced on a central pivot and pointing steadily in one direction. Soft fog hides the Sun. Must NOT show: any letters N, E, S, W or numbers on the compass face, a glowing needle, a map with words, or a smartphone.
